definitions.explanation: a larger than standard serving size of food, especially rice or noodles

examples.japanese: ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧{大盛|おおも}り⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: A large serving of rice, please.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{大盛|おおも}りにした。
examples.english: I got a large portion of ramen.

examples.japanese: {大盛|おおも}り⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{百円|ひゃくえん}⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧です。
examples.english: A large serving costs an extra 100 yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{空|す}いて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{大盛|おおも}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I ordered a large portion because I was hungry.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大盛|おおも}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧だ。
examples.english: This restaurant offers free large servings.

notes:
RELATED SERVING SIZES:
- {小盛|こも}り (small serving)
- ⟦{並盛|なみも}り→並盛り：15015_namimori⟧ / {普通盛|ふつうも}り (regular serving)
- {大盛|おおも}り (large serving)
- ⟦{特盛|とくも}り→特盛り：15014_tokumori⟧ (extra-large serving)
- メガ⟦{盛|も}り→盛り：13696_mori⟧ (mega serving)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {大盛|おおも}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make it a large serving)
- {大盛|おおも}り⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧ (free large portion upgrade)
- ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧{大盛|おおも}り (large rice serving)

USAGE:
Many Japanese restaurants offer {大盛|おおも}り for free or at a small extra charge. Some ramen shops particularly are known for generous {大盛|おおも}り options.
